name: Saijou Mia
source:
The only daughter of a wealthy family.
She is selfish because she has been brought up to do whatever she wants, so she thinks that nothing will stop her from achieving her goals. 
Perhaps because she has been living a luxurious life since she can remember, she has a habit of looking down on common people and the poor.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
